newsitem.title: MEXICO: Visa plans to increase share capital.
newsitem.headline: Visa plans to increase share capital.

text.p: Mexican holding firm Valores Industriales S.A. (Visa) said on Tuesday that it planned to increase its share capital by 115.61 million pesos, a move approved at a special shareholders' meeting on August 30.
Visa will boost share capital by 96.86 million pesos by capitalizing retained earnings, according to information released to the Mexican Stock Exchange.
The remaining 18.75 million pesos will be raised by a shareholders' subscription of one "Q" series share per each 5.3752695 outstanding shares at a price of 44 pesos each.
The subscription will take place within 15 days starting Tuesday, Visa added.
Visa's share capital will total 119,536,304 pesos after the increase, compared with a current 3,927,579 pesos.
